description: Integration test verifying snow_connector.py (built 2026-04-16) is wired into approval_workflow. Test sequence: (1) POST a sample MCP submission to mcp_submissions via write_service, (2) trigger approval_workflow processing, (3) verify snow_connector receives the verdict payload, (4) assert snow_connector writes to the expected SNOW table structure. Mock the SNOW API endpoint to avoid real external calls. Use write_service query to verify no database errors occurred. Exit 0 on success, exit 1 with diagnostic message on any step failure.
